question: Which FTIR band did the authors use to tell whether PVDF remained in the reclaimed cathode powder, and for which filtration condition was that band absent?
expect: 871 cm^-1 (CH2 bending); absent for the powder filtered hot (~100 °C), present after room-temperature filtration (p4.L46-55)
rendered:
The authors used the FTIR band at 871 cm−1, which can be ascribed to the bending vibration of CH2, to tell whether PVDF remained in the reclaimed cathode powder. 

This band was absent in the reclaimed powder that was filtered at high temperature (e.g., 100 °C).
